tables.name: Outside the City
tables.description: The prominent locations outside the city proper (Very Small 5, Small 4, Medium 3, Large 2, Very Large 1 rolls). A Production priority's first roll is a d10 rerolling 1-4: its d6 variant, the same odds.

results.name: None
results.description: If you have any remaining rolls to make on this table, proceed with them.

results.name: Farming [Agriculture]
results.description: A group of farms, providing food for the city, are found on the nearest hospitable land under its control.

results.name: Farming [Livestock]
results.description: A group of farms, providing livestock for the city, are found on the nearest hospitable land under its control.

results.name: Resource Harvesting
results.description: Depending on the landscape and available resources (trees, minerals, ore, stone, etc.), a logging camp, mine, or quarry, belonging to the city, has been built nearby to harvest them, which it then uses or sells.

results.name: Barrows
results.description: An area devoted to burial sites.

results.name: Caravan Community
results.description: A nomadic group of people have taken to living on the surrounding land nearby. Does the city’s leadership have an issue with this? What about its residents?

results.name: Event Grounds
results.description: Tended grounds for games, duels, ceremonies, or other events.

results.name: Family Estate
results.description: A wealthy family’s large estate is situated in the neighboring countryside.

results.name: Hermit’s Cottage
results.description: A hermit lives near the city limits, beneath the notice of most of the inhabitants. They keep to themselves, but who are they? What do they gain by their close proximity?

results.name: Makeshift Settlement
results.description: A large mass of hovels, lean-tos, tents, and other improvised shelters have been built in the shadow of the city’s walls. Why? Do the leaders and residents care?

results.name: Medical Camp
results.description: A set of makeshift or, depending on the nature of what is being treated, permanent structures have been erected to tend to, or even quarantine, the sick or injured.

results.name: Prison
results.description: Some sort of structure out here has been designated for holding prisoners or captives (for whatever reason) either temporarily or, perhaps, much longer term.
